_comment: Phase 5 Random Forest baseline configuration. Single source of truth for the baseline run: one interpretable model, one configuration, no hyperparameter search, no competing models, no synthetic data. Every script reads this file and records resolved values in its own outputs.
authorisation: User explicitly moved RESQAI to Phase 5 (modelling) on 2026-10-28; baseline Random Forest only.
objective: Estimate relative landslide susceptibility conditional on the observed inventory - a ranking task, not a calibrated probability; never a forecast, warning or timing prediction.

class_handling.meaning: positive = mapped landslide event point from the audited inventory; background = no mapped landslide at that location in the available inventory (NOT confirmed stable ground). The 5.78:1 background:positive ratio is a sampling-design artefact, not a class prior.

model.rationale: Single fixed configuration, no tuning: 500 trees for stable importances; min_samples_leaf=5 so single-cell noise cannot dominate; class_weight=balanced_subsample so the arbitrary background density does not dominate the fit; the rest are sklearn defaults. Interpretability comes from documented settings plus permutation importance on held-out folds.

fold_usage.rule: For each fold f in 0..4: test = every point with fold==f (positives and background); train = every point with fold!=f EXCEPT the point_ids listed in fold_drops.csv with fold==f (the committed 1,000 m buffer). Fold labels come from the Phase 4 files and are never reassigned; no random split is created.
fold_usage.consistency_check: constructed train/test counts must equal fold_summary.json per-fold counts before fitting

metrics.interpretation: Spatially held-out presence-background RANKING metrics (case-control): roc_auc = probability a random mapped event ranks above a random background point; average_precision = ranking quality under heavy background prevalence. They are not accuracy on all Wayanad landslides, not performance on confirmed absences, and not calibrated skill. Folds are spatially adjacent and correlated; only per-fold values and their unweighted mean are reported, never a pooled score presented as independent.

permutation_importance.computed_on: each fold's held-out test set; aggregated across folds as mean +/- sd (interpretive, not a performance claim)

features.soilgrid_scaling: ALREADY APPLIED in Phase 3 (scripts/p3_soil.py): clay/sand/silt/soc/cec/cfvo divided by 10, bdod divided by 100. Features are in physical units; Phase 5 must NOT re-apply scale factors.
features.chirps_nodata: sentinel -9999 was masked in Phase 3 (scripts/p3_rainfall.py); extraction still asserts no rainfall value <= -9998.
features.categorical_rule: land cover and geology are categorical: extracted at the containing cell (nearest), never interpolated.
features.extraction_rule: every feature is the value of the source cell containing the point (no resampling, source rasters read-only).

map.enabled_after: fold evaluation and predictor extraction pass documented checks (scripts/p5_verify.py gates 2-4)
map.domain: district mask AND all 24 predictor layers valid
map.model: final RandomForest refit on ALL 2,460 committed points (this model is NOT cross-validated; its skill characterisation is the fold evaluation)
map.value: RF positive-class vote share predict_proba[:, 1] - a RELATIVE RANKING score, not a calibrated probability
map.label: relative landslide susceptibility ranking conditional on the observed inventory (92.3% of labels from 2018); not a probability, forecast, warning, or timing prediction

limitations: spatially held-out presence-background ranking metrics on an inventory that is 92.3% single-year (2018); scores characterise that event population, not all Wayanad landslides
no viable temporal holdout exists (28 non-2018 labels across 17 clusters); temporal transfer is untested
background labels mean 'no mapped event in the available inventory', not confirmed stable terrain; ranking metrics treat them as the comparison class, not as verified absences
the 5.78:1 background:positive ratio is a sampling-design artefact (density choice), mitigated in-fit by class weighting
folds are spatially adjacent; per-fold scores are correlated and their mean is not an independent-replication estimate
categorical predictors enter as integer codes (no target or ordinal encoding), a known RF baseline simplification
aspect enters as a linear 0-360 degree value despite being circular
training near misses and survey effort are unmodelled: the inventory reflects where mapping happened, not everywhere landsliding happened
